title: DIMSTYLE DWG encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated local DIMSTYLE direct-codec transaction control across legacy inline, detached, separate, and aliased stream layouts

implementation.behavior: Catch allocation failures throughout field/color preflight and body construction, stage each distinct body/string/handle destination, and publish only after every stream succeeds. Existing versioned DIMSTYLE scalars, strings, CMC colors, common handles, and resource handle order are preserved; public and typed-null routes share the staged path.

control.profile: Locally generated DIMSTYLE with two reactors, extension dictionary, dimension text/suffix strings, nondefault scalar settings, and all modeled xref/text-style/block/linetype handles.
control.failure_assertions: Every reached one-shot allocation failure leaves caller body, strings, handles, cursors, health, and handle-occurrence ledgers unchanged. The same object and buffers then retry to clean output.

validation.result: The allocation control reports all seven layouts passing rollback/retry across 192 offsets. All ten focused CTests passed, including ASCII/Binary dwg2dxf readback.

limits: Generated local transaction evidence only; it does not broaden DIMSTYLE producer, revision, or wire-layout qualification.
The typed-null writer route shares the staged implementation but was not separately fault-injected in this receipt.
Native dimension rendering and whole-document source/reference closure remain separately gated.
